newsitem.title: USA: NASDAQ Feb short interest rises to 1.36 bln shrs.
newsitem.headline: NASDAQ Feb short interest rises to 1.36 bln shrs.

text.p: Nasdaq said on Wednesday that February short interest grew to 1.36 billion shares from 1.32 billion shares reported in January.
The February short interest represents 2.08 days of average daily volume compared to 2.38 days in January, Nasdaq said.
As of mid-February, short interest in the Nasdaq National Market securities total 1.31 billion shares versus 1.27 billion shares in National Market issues for the month of January.
The February short interest represents 2.21 days of average daily Nasdaq National Market volume compared to 2.57 days in January, Nasdaq said.

A short sale is generally understood to mean the sale of a security that the seller does not own or any sale that is consummated by the delivery of a security borrowed by or for the account of the seller, Nasdaq said. A short sale is often viewed as a bet that a particular stock will decline in price.
Figures this month include all short positions reported January 16 through February 11, and settled as of February 14.
